note: The Waitlist's one contract file (US-WL01). Every later story reads these values instead of retyping them. The wording, the Fit answers, the Source tags, unknown and none are the captain-approved text of the Waitlist request (the PRD's Appendix A) and tools/waitlist/test-check-view.py fails when any of them drifts from it. The posted email field name is the one Kit's sign-up endpoint takes (email_address, the PRD's verified fact V2), because OQ1 Option A posts there; the other three are Kit custom fields posted as fields[<key>] and the spike (artifacts/reports/US-WL06/spike.md) confirmed Kit stores them under the keys fit, beta_opt_in and source. A fourth Kit custom field, entry, holds the entry identifier: the producer writes it, the form never posts it (a public post can set it, so the producer trusts only its own ledger). Renaming a posted field after go-live means a migration. The view rules mirror gr0wthlab's reader (src/gr0wthlab/waitlist.py); check-view.py enforces them.
